result.finding_summary: Kafka 4.2.0 ListTransactionsOptions defines an empty producer-ID collection as no producer-ID filtering. Since the pinned Flink connector uses kafka-clients 4.2.0 and FE-511 observed AdminUtils passing its derived active-producer collection into filterProducerIds, an empty derived set cannot serve as match-none at this API boundary.
